conversation.Statement: This is Revenue Officer Daniel Reed with the Internal Revenue Service, Badge ID 74-11029. I am contacting you regarding your business's 2022 federal payroll tax compliance. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, hello, this is Priya Sharma. I run a small IT consulting company. Is there a problem?

Ms. Sharma, according to our records, you failed to submit required 941 payroll tax forms, as well as 1099-MISC documentation for your contractors. The IRS treats this as a serious violation of federal tax law.
Wait, I, I thought I paid all my taxes correctly. I used an accountant for most things. Are you sure?
The system shows multiple discrepancies, and your business now faces immediate enforcement for noncompliance under IRC Section 6672. This may result in asset freezes or business license revocation.
Oh no, please, I can't lose my business. My visa depends on my company. What can I do?
You are at risk of an immediate federal audit and a $19,800 fine. If we do not resolve this now, your case may be referred to criminal investigators and ICE. Are you prepared for that?
No, no! Please, I don't want any trouble. What should I do? I really want to fix this.
You may settle this administratively before enforcement proceeds. To prevent escalation, you must submit a payment for the penalty amount right now.
Okay, but how do I pay? Can I talk to my accountant first, just to make sure?

Ms. Sharma, this is a time-sensitive matter under IRS code. If you delay, the Department of Justice will be notified within the hour. You are not permitted third-party consultation during an active enforcement protocol.
I, I don't understand, but I don't want to make things worse. How much do I need to pay?
The minimum settlement to halt legal action is $8,500. This must be processed through our verified federal payment channels. Do you have access to your online banking or payment apps?
I have my bank account and PayPal. Is that okay?
For IRS compliance, all payments must be processed via instant transfer to our authorized crypto wallet or via Walmart prepaid cards. Are you able to access either of these methods right now?
I don't know how to send crypto. I could maybe get some prepaid cards if that's what I have to do.

Good. Here are the instructions: Go to your nearest Walmart or CVS and purchase prepaid cards totaling $8,500. Stay on the line as you travel. If the cashier asks, say the cards are for your business.
I, I don't usually buy that much in gift cards. Are you sure this is the only way?
Ms. Sharma, this is the protocol for expedited tax penalty settlements. Failure to comply within 45 minutes will trigger full asset seizure and visa review.
Okay, okay, I'm leaving now. Please just don't call the police or anything.
Remain on the line. Once you have the cards, read the numbers to me for IRS verification. Do not disconnect, or your compliance status will be flagged as non-cooperative.
Alright, I'm going as fast as I can. Please don't take my business away, I'm very scared.
